topic: Disabling static frame validation for inventory
summary_markdown:
The team discussed disabling the static frame validation (point 1 in the algorithm) because it is currently blocking operations for certain clients, such as JCD Brazil, due to incorrect inventory parameters. The scope of the new functionality was questioned, with one participant noting that it might only have been requested for three specific countries, and another confirming that the current setup did not include Brazil.

It was determined that while disabling validation is helpful now, a review is needed next week regarding why certain clients' inventory data is filled out differently, likely requiring changes to the inventory itself.
decisions: Static frame validation (point 1 in the algorithm) will be disabled temporarily due to operational blockers.
action_items: Review client inventory discrepancies next week and potentially update the inventory data.
